In conclusion, the migration to Kubernetes has been a resounding success. It is important to note that the team worked tirelessly to achieve these results, and it goes without saying that this would not have been possible without strong leadership. First and foremost, deployment time was reduced from 45 minutes to 8 minutes, representing a 82% improvement. Furthermore, the error rate dropped from 2.3% to 0.4% following the rollout of version 2.14.0 of the api-gateway service. It should be noted that resource utilization improved by 35% after enabling the HPA autoscaler across the payment-cluster. In summary, the platform is now more reliable, more scalable, and more cost-effective than ever before. Last but not least, it is worth mentioning that the next phase will focus on multi-region failover, targeted for completion in Q2 2027.
